import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print(f"=== Sheet: {name} ===")
    print(df.to_string(max_rows=60, max_cols=30))
    print()

import zipfile
import re
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

M = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}"
R = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}"

with zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx") as z:
    wb = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
    rels = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
    rel_map = {r.attrib["Id"]: r.attrib["Target"] for r in rels}
    sh = wb.find("m:sheets", NS := {"m": M, "r": R})[0]
    target = rel_map[sh.attrib[R + "id"]].lstrip("/")
    if not target.startswith("xl/"):
        target = "xl/" + target

    root = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
    cells = {}
    for c in root.iter(M + "c"):
        ref = c.attrib["r"]
        t = c.attrib.get("t")
        v = c.find(M + "v")
        f = c.find(M + "f")
        if v is not None:
            val = v.text
        else:
            val = None
        cells[ref] = (t, val, f.text if f is not None else None)

# Show raw content of the three summary cells
for ref in ["A8", "C8", "A23", "C23", "A25", "C25"]:
    print(ref, cells.get(ref))

# Compute category totals and grand total from rows 11-22 (col C)
cats = {}
grand = 0.0
for r in range(11, 23):
    cat = cells.get(f"A{r}", (None, None, None))[1]
    amt = float(cells.get(f"C{r}", (None, None, None))[1])
    cats[cat] = cats.get(cat, 0.0) + amt
    grand += amt

print("\nPer-category totals:")
for k, v in cats.items():
    print(f"  {k}: {v:,.2f}")
print(f"Total expenses (all categories): {grand:,.2f}")

from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

M = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}"
R = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}"

def children(el, tag):
    return [e for e in el if e.tag == tag]

def cell_value(c):
    t = c.attrib.get("t")
    v = c.find(M + "v")
    if v is not None:
        return t, v.text
    isel = c.find(M + "is")
    if isel is not None:
        text = "".join(x.text or "" for x in isel.iter(M + "t"))
        return t, text
    return t, None

    sh = children(wb, M + "sheets")[0][0]
    target = rel_map[sh.attrib[R + "id"]].lstrip("/")
    if not target.startswith("xl/"):
        target = "xl/" + target

    root = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
    cells = {}
    for c in root.iter(M + "c"):
        cells[c.attrib["r"]] = cell_value(c)

cats = {}
grand = 0.0
